purpose: Establish byte identity and raw IBKR structural validity of the exact archived snapshot before parsing or emitting any economic row value.
allowed: download exactly the frozen archived snapshot without following to any different capture timestamp
compute byte length and SHA-256 over exact response body
strictly decode only structural marker lines beginning with #BOF, #SYM and #EOF
record BOF date/time, exact header names/order, EOF declared row count
count physical data rows without decoding their fields
validate expected canonical fields SYM, CON, ISIN, REBATERATE, FEERATE and AVAILABLE are present
forbidden: emit, parse, summarize, rank or inspect any economic row values
open FEERATE, REBATERATE or AVAILABLE cell values
infer full-month coverage from one snapshot
use credentials, API keys or account login
pass_requires: exactly one BOF marker and one SYM header and one EOF marker
header contains SYM, CON, ISIN, REBATERATE, FEERATE, AVAILABLE
physical data row count equals EOF declared row count if EOF count is numeric
no HTML/Wayback error document masquerading as data
successor_rule: Passing this preflight authenticates one point-in-time raw IBKR snapshot only. Full-month recovery still requires a separately frozen month-coverage discovery/admission gate.
